🔥 The fire settles. Jasper has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sweeps Week — I put it down today." "The grass stops moving the way wind moves it. Two amber eyes — then the whole striped avalanche." "It circles, unhurried. It has seen this episode before — and it knows how it ends." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Wei mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Brooklyn says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
"We've been watching you figure things out all week! This one's on us — a head start! But the REAL power? That comes from UNDERSTANDING. Use it! Learn it! The gamblers are watching!"
